question: Who among the following was one of the winners of Nobel Prize in Physics 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is__ **Roger Penrose.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Roger Penrose** was one of the winners of the Nobel Prize in Physics 2020.
 
• Roger Penrose of** Britain, Reinhard Genzel of Germany, and Andrea Ghez of the US won the Nobel Physics Prize for 2020.**
 
• The physicists were selected for their discoveries about one of the most exotic phenomena in the universe, the black hole.
 
• Andrea Ghez is just the fourth woman to receive the physics prize since** 1901 when the first Nobel prizes** were handed out.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Roger Penrose** used ingenious mathematical methods in his proof that black holes are a direct consequence of Albert Einstein's general theory of relativity.
 
• Einstein did not himself believe that black holes really exist, these super-heavyweight monsters that capture everything that enters them. Nothing can escape, not even light.
 
• **Reinhard Genzel and Andrea Ghez **each lead a group of astronomers that, since the early 1990s, have focused on a region called **Sagittarius A*** at the centre of our galaxy.
 
• Their pioneering work has given us the most convincing evidence yet of a supermassive black hole at the centre of the Milky Way.
